attorneys: Henry E. Foley for appellant., Solicitor General Perlman and Edward M. Reidy for the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission; and Francis L. Brown, R. J. Fletcher and John Dickinson for the' Pennsylvania Railroad Co. et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:
